note: Claude publishes questions here by pushing to the repo. Answers are stored in your synced dashboard data, and 'Copy answers' puts them on the clipboard to paste back into a Claude session.

questions.question: Are the six lists right — Inbox, Next actions, Projects, Waiting for, Someday/maybe, Done?
questions.why: I picked standard GTD. If you think in different lists (e.g. a 'Today' shortlist, or splitting work from personal), the buckets are one constant to change.

questions.question: Contexts are seeded as Office, Home, DIY, Home PC, Outdoor errands. Any to add or drop?
questions.why: You can edit these in the app, but if there's an obvious missing one (Phone? Waiting-on-Tamara? Car?) I'd rather it were there from the start.

questions.question: When a bring-forward date arrives, should the task move itself into Next actions, or just nudge you?
questions.why: Right now it only nudges and stays in whichever list it was in. Auto-moving is more automatic but decides for you.
options: Auto-move back to Inbox to re-decide

questions.question: Should completed tasks be cleared out automatically after a while?
questions.why: Done tasks are hidden behind a toggle but never deleted, so the document grows forever and syncs on every save.

questions.question: Of the two things still outstanding, which do you want first?
questions.why: You picked both earlier: cleaning up duplicate tags that already exist, and a mobile layout pass.

questions.question: For project reference links — is OneNote the right assumption, and do your links share a common prefix?
questions.why: The link field takes any URL. If your notes live somewhere with a predictable URL shape I can make it one tap instead of a paste.
